title: Amaboko yavumwe
intro: Uhagaze mu tuyira twinshi twa Makka ya kera, aho umuntu w’icyubahiro n’ubutunzi yigeze kuva mu muhamagaro w’ukuri. Inkuru y’uyu muntu ni urwibutso rukomeye rw’uko amasasu y’amaraso adashobora gutsinda iminyururu y’ubwibone. Ni nde uyu witwa ko izina rye rihuye n’umuriro utegereje?
clues: Nanyuze mu mihanda ya Makka mfite ishema ryampumye amaso ntamenya ukuri, nubwo intumwa yari iy'amaraso yanjye bwite.
Ibintu byanjye byari byinshi, ariko byabaye umuvumo aho kuba ingabo.
Igitabo cy'ubuyobozi kivuga ku kurimbuka kwanjye, kivuga ko amaboko yanjye n'umubiri wanjye bizashira.
Uwo twashakanye yifatanyije nanjye mu gikorwa cyanjye cyo kwanga, akusanya amahwa yo gukwirakwira mu nzira y'uwahamagaye Allah.
Ku munsi w'urubanza, nzajugunywa mu muriro w'umuriro ugurumana, kandi uwo twashakanye azaba afite umugozi w'umugozi w'ikiganza mu ijosi.
Nzwi ku izina risobanura 'se w'umuriro' - izina rigaragaza ubuturo bwanjye bw'iteka ryose.

trial.label: Igeragezwa ry'ingenzi cyangwa igikorwa
options: Yarwanyije Intumwa maze aravumwa muri Korowani
Yayoboye ingabo kugira ngo zisenye Kaaba
Yanze kwemera ko ukwezi kwacitsemo kabiri
Yubatse umunara kugira ngo agere mu ijuru
trial.answer: Yarwanyije Intumwa maze aravumwa muri Korowani

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Azinjira mu muriro ugurumana, kandi ubutunzi bwe ntibuzamugirira akamaro
outcome.answer: Azinjira mu muriro ugurumana, kandi ubutunzi bwe ntibuzamugirira akamaro
